disclosures.text: An apparatus for processing a biomass material
A first treatment cell equipped with a first electron beam device
The first treatment cell irradiates biomass material with electron beams
A screw conveyor for cooling the biomass material
A screw conveyor for conveying the biomass material from the first treatment cell
An apparatus comprising a first electron beam treatment cell and a screw conveyor for cooling and conveying biomass
A second treatment cell equipped with a second electron beam device
The second electron beam device further irradiates the biomass material
Irradiating with the second electron beam device delivers a dose rate of at least 1 Mrad per second
The screw conveyor includes interior portions that are cooled
The interior portions are cooled using a chilled liquid
The interior portions include a hollow shaft and hollow flight
A geothermal ground loop for cooling the chilled liquid
The interior portions are cooled using water or glycol water mixtures
The water or glycol water mixtures are chilled by a geothermal ground loop
Cooling reduces biomass temperature by between 1° C. and 110° C.
Cooling reduces biomass temperature by between 10° C. and 75° C.
Cooling reduces biomass temperature by between 10° C. and 50° C.
A total dose delivered is between 1 and 200 Mrad
A total dose delivered is between 10 Mrad and 50 Mrad
A total dose delivered is between 20 Mrad and 40 Mrad
Biomass temperature during irradiation does not exceed 160° C.
Biomass temperature during irradiation increases by between 75° C. and 150° C.
The biomass includes a lignocellulosic material

The biomass is selected from wood, particle board, sawdust, agricultural waste, sewage, silage, grasses, rice hulls, bagasse, cotton, jute, hemp, flax, bamboo, sisal, abaca, straw, corn cobs, corn stover, switchgrass, alfalfa, hay, coconut
The screw conveyor includes two or more screws
Irradiating with the first electron beam delivers a dose rate of at least 1 Mrad per second
The screw conveyor has a material inlet and a material discharge
The temperature difference of biomass between inlet and discharge is less than 110° C.
The biomass material is comminuted while it is conveyed
